partition_policy: Keep the original 32 development and 8 holdout families and all five variants together; no relabeling or new families.
operating_point_policy: Descriptive comparisons only: maximize correct recall among nonempty proposal sets meeting the precision floor; ties use greater precision then higher threshold. Do not tune or change defaults after observing holdout results.
candidate_metric_policy: Count the first five ranked candidates including ineligible pairs, exactly as the original protocol; report unique and ambiguous retrieval separately. Small schemas can make retrieval deceptively easy.
holdout_policy: Default execution and --check score development only. --acknowledge-holdout permits the final frozen qualification run. It cannot be combined with --check. Published holdout results are never independent evidence for subsequent tuning on these families.
provenance: Original Fieldkin synthetic fixtures under MIT OR Apache-2.0; original protocol, corpus and lockfile are retained and hashed in every report.
limitations: Eight held-out families and correlated variants do not establish production accuracy. Objective scores are heuristics, not probabilities. Failing a quality target is reported rather than waived.
